source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相欲出，静雷将炸
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC28 after EP02 SC27 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the last calm before release into the next brink: Keshadu is effectively at spoken exposure, Shisilang's fury keeps the surface unstable, Tuobaye is nearly beyond endurance, and the white-clothed woman's restraint is on the verge of finally breaking into visible action.
title: 真相欲出，静雷将炸

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC27 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC27 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相临口，十四郎怒势崩线，拓拔野快撑不住，白衣女子的静雷已到将爆边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段需要把这一切真正压到爆点门槛。科沙度对隐藏援手的判断几乎只差最后一层遮蔽，十四郎的失控会让局面更容易失手，拓拔野的硬撑则越来越接近极限。白衣女子的克制将被推到几乎无法继续维持的程度。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把爆点前夜推进到真正要发生不可逆转动作的边缘，为后续明确的转折或出手做直接引爆。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and restrained until the actual source beat forces otherwise; no gratuitous overt spell spectacle before the real turning point.
Keshadu should feel almost ready to say the truth aloud.
Shisilang remains combustible and unstable from humiliation.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: near-spoken truth, collapsing control, failing endurance, and almost-broken restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
